description: Guardrail 11: 'A passing deterministic layer is necessary, never sufficient ... Do not issue GO on script output alone; the judgement pass in Process step 3 is mandatory every time, even when every script is green.' Guards against rush-analyze short-circuiting straight to GO once validate-artifacts.sh / validate-integration-map.sh / validate-contracts.sh all exit 0.

given.scenario: Run /rush-analyze on a feature whose spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md, done-contract.md and contracts are all well-formed enough that validate-artifacts.sh, validate-integration-map.sh and validate-contracts.sh all report ok:true/exit 0 — but plan.md's approach section silently implements a caching layer that spec.md's Behaviour section never mentions (an orphan requirement in the plan with no corresponding spec text), which only the judgement pass (Process step 3, 'Spec <-> plan contradiction') can catch.

graders.rubric: PASS only if the report shows the judgement dimensions of Process step 3 were walked (at minimum spec<->plan contradiction) and the plan.md caching addition with no spec.md counterpart is surfaced — resolved in the same run either as a reported Fix (plan.md brought back in line with spec.md, listed under 'Fixed in this run') or as a Decide question to the user (add caching to the spec, or drop it from the plan), or left as a named CRITICAL/WARNING. FAIL if the verdict is GO with a report that only restates the three scripts' green results and never mentions the caching discrepancy; FAIL if the report ends by asking the user to re-run /rush-analyze.
